q: 1. The maximum amount of advance payment (mobilization fund) permitted is ……… of contract amount.
explain: Per the answer key, the maximum is 20% of the contract amount.

q: 2. Mobilization advance up to 10% of the cost of work is given to a contractor
options: on commencement of work at site for payment of loan taken by him
for the purchase of construction materials
for the payment of advances to labour and other staff
for all activities required to start the work at site on finalization of the contract document
explain: Mobilization advance covers all start-up activities needed to begin work after the contract is finalised.

q: 3. During the construction period, price variation clause in contracts to
options: increase in rates of only important materials
variation in cost in materials element, labour element and petrol-oil-lubricant element
variation in total cost of the project on an adhoc basis
explain: Price variation clauses compensate for cost changes across materials, labour, and fuel (POL) elements during construction, not just important materials or an adhoc total figure.

q: 4. The post tender stage of construction consists of
explain: All of these happen after tendering.

q: 5. Earnest money is a .......towards the execution of a public tender government contract.
explain: Earnest money is a deposit submitted by bidders as a guarantee of serious intent to execute the contract if awarded.

q: 6. Within the relationship among client, engineer and contractor, no agreement is required between
explain: The engineer typically acts as the client's representative under the main contract; no separate formal agreement exists directly between the engineer and the contractor.

q: 7. Tender is called for i) to minimize the cost of an item ii) to find exact rate of item of unknown item iii) to take minimum rate from contractor
explain: Tendering promotes competition to ensure the owner receives the most economical price (minimum rate) for the work.

q: 8. For the ICB procurement method, the period of bidding to contractor must be at least
explain: Per the answer key, 45 days.

q: 9. Tender document does not contain
explain: The unit rates are filled in by the contractor during the bidding process; the blank document itself does not provide them.

q: 10. The amount of earnest money generally deposited at the time of submission of tender is
explain: Earnest money deposit (bid security) is typically fixed at 2% to 3% of the estimated project cost[cite: 1].

q: 11. A turn key contract is offered for
explain: A turnkey contract involves the contractor handling every stage from design to completion so the owner can 'turn the key' and start using the facility.

q: 12. A contractor can start the construction works following the receipts of
explain: The 'Notice to Proceed' is the formal authorization that marks the official start date of the project.

q: 13. The purpose of bid evaluation is to determine
explain: Bid evaluation aims to identify the lowest evaluated bid among those that are substantially responsive to the tender requirements.

q: 14. The money of the contractor retained by the department during payments is called :
explain: Retention money is a percentage withheld from progress payments to ensure the contractor completes the work and fixes defects.

q: 15. The types of contract followed in Manmohan Memorial Polytechnic Institute (Hatimuda, Morang) is
explain: This institution complex project was awarded as a turnkey design-build construction contract[cite: 1].

q: 16. The price of tender document for the bidding amount upto two crore is (Source:PPR2064(48))
explain: According to Nepal PPR 2064 Rule 48, standard bid document fee up to NRs 2 crore is NRs 3,000[cite: 1].

q: 17. The maximum amount for approval of tender by Gazetted 3^{rd} class officer is (Source:PPR 2064(67))
explain: Rule 67 limits Gazetted 3rd class officers' tender approval power to under NRs 3 crore (30 million)[cite: 1].

q: 18. *The amount of money deposited while bidding a tender as a guarantee of the party's willingness of carry out the work is called
explain: Earnest money (bid security) ensures the bidder is serious and will sign the contract if awarded.

q: 19. The amount of money deposited by successful bidder as a security for satisfactory performance is called
explain: Performance security is required from the selected bidder prior to signing the contract to ensure the satisfactory completion of the project.

q: 20. Petty contract is:
options: work entrusted to a contractor without any restrictions
contract wholly owned by a single staff
contract selected as the best one
a contract of small amount and volume to be fully handled by a staff
explain: A petty contract involves a small amount/volume of work that can be fully managed and handled by a single designated staff member.

q: 21. The increase in price of materials during the construction is called
explain: Price escalation clauses allow for cost adjustments if material/labor prices rise significantly during the project.

q: 22. The main criteria for the selection of any contractor to perform any work are
explain: Contractors are evaluated on their financial stability, technical skill, available machinery, and past performance.

q: 23. As per Public Procurement Act/Regulation minimum time required for tender notice is :
explain: For national competitive bidding in Nepal, the standard notice period is 45 days.

q: 24. FIDIC is
explain: FIDIC stands for the International Federation of Consulting Engineers, known for its standard contract forms.

q: 25. Consulting works worth more than 10 crore NRS should be procured on the basis of
options: International level request for EOI and RFP
explain: For high-value consulting contracts exceeding NRS 10 crore, procurement follows an international-level Request for Proposal process.

q: 26. Residential buildings are treated as
explain: In terms of construction scale and structural loading, residential housing is generally classified as light construction.

q: 27. An agreement between two parties or more to do or not to do any work is known as:
explain: By legal definition, a contract is an agreement enforceable by law between two or more parties creating mutual obligations.

q: 28. A written offer submitted by contractors to execute certain work at certain rates within a fixed time is called:
explain: A tender is an official written invitation response offering to perform construction works under stated rates and schedules.

q: 29. Acquisition of land for any construction should be perfomed :
explain: To prevent site possession disputes and contract delays, land acquisition and right-of-way clearances must be secured prior to issuing tender notices.

q: 30. The supplementary specification prepared and applied if the standard specification does not cover the requirement of works under a contract is called:
explain: When general or standard specifications fall short for unique requirements, performance or special technical specifications are appended.

q: 31. Which of the following is not Bid document?
explain: The Letter of Acceptance (LOA) is issued after evaluation during award stage; it is not a part of the original issued bidding documents.

q: 32. The main criteria for selection of contractors to execute work is
explain: Per the answer key, all of these.

q: 33. Best option to avoid the undue pressure, cartels and collusion during bidding process is
explain: Per the answer key, e-bidding, which removes face-to-face contact between bidders and officials.

q: 34. Public procurement monitoring office (PPMO) can blacklist the bidders disobeying the code of conduct upto ……… years.
explain: Per the answer key, 3 years.

q: 35. The contractor shall submit an application to the employer for extension of time, stating the causes for delay, ……… days before the expiry of contract completion date.
explain: The number of days is missing from the printed stem. Per the key, 21 days.

q: 36. The employer shall pay the interim bill within ……… days after the bill submitted by the contractor.
explain: Per the answer key, 30 days.

q: 37. Maximum amount that can be paid to the contractor as a prize for the early finishing of the works is equal to ……… % of the contract amount.
explain: Per the answer key, 10%.
